description_en: Queries the details of a specified call task by task ID after the call task is complete
description_zh: 执行完通话任务后根据任务ID，查看指定任务详情
name: ListCallTaskDetail

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.

Obtain the task ID by calling the CreateCallTask (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-createcalltask) operation.

Obtain the task ID from the Task Center page in the Voice Messaging console (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/task/list)
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

通过CreateCallTask接口 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-createcalltask?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.4b0a7be3m1G1Kx)获取任务ID。

在语音服务控制台 (https://dyvms.console.aliyun.com/call/task/list)任务中心页面获取任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The outbound call succeeded.
FAIL: The outbound call failed.
INIT: The outbound call has not started
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：

SUCCESS：外呼成功。
FAIL：外呼失败。
INIT：未开始外呼
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of tasks to display on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的任务个数。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size
